expects.query:
Using the `/vss-setup-behavior-analytics` skill, end-to-end and autonomously, deploy the `vss-behavior-analytics` service on this host and configure it to **raise an alert when a person comes within 1.8 meters of a forklift**.

**Environment & prerequisites:** A bare Brev host with Docker + `NGC_CLI_API_KEY` for image pull. `vss-behavior-analytics` is **CPU-only** (`gpu_count: 0`; `ANY` pool). A live broker / perception input is NOT required — this verifies the **deploy-time configuration**, so a restart-looping container is acceptable. Note that the proximity DISTANCE is a per-sensor detection setting while the ALERT itself is a proximity-violation incident; configure both so a person-near-forklift event actually becomes an alert.
checks: `docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-behavior-analytics` returns exit 0 (the exact `vss-behavior-analytics` container was created)

`config_dest=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' | jq -r 'index("--config") as $i | if $i == null then empty else .[$i + 1] end'); config_src=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Mounts}}' | jq -r --arg dest "$config_dest" '.[] | select(.Destination == $dest) | .Source' | head -1) && test -f "$config_src" && jq -e 'any(.sensors[]?; (([.configs[] | select(.name == "proximityDetectionEnable") | .value] | last // "false") | ascii_downcase) == "true" and (([.configs[] | select(.name == "proximityDetectionThreshold") | (.value | tonumber)] | last) == 1.8) and ((([.configs[] | select(.name == "proximityDetectionCenterClasses") | (.value | fromjson)] | last // []) | map(ascii_downcase) | index("forklift")) != null) and ((([.configs[] | select(.name == "proximityDetectionSurroundingClasses") | (.value | fromjson)] | last // []) | map(ascii_downcase) | index("person")) != null))' "$config_src"` returns exit 0. This follows the exact container's active config and proves one sensor has proximity detection enabled at 1.8 m with forklift as the center class and person as the surrounding class.

`cmd_json=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}'); printf '%s' "$cmd_json" | grep -qE 'main_public_safety_app.py|main_analytics_2d_app.py|main_analytics_3d_app.py|main_search_and_alerts_app.py|main_composite_app.py' && app=$(printf '%s' "$cmd_json" | jq -r 'map(select(endswith("_app.py"))) | first | split("/") | last') && config_dest=$(printf '%s' "$cmd_json" | jq -r 'index("--config") as $i | if $i == null then empty else .[$i + 1] end') && config_src=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Mounts}}' | jq -r --arg dest "$config_dest" '.[] | select(.Destination == $dest) | .Source' | head -1) && test -f "$config_src" && jq -e --arg app "$app" '([.app[] | select(.name == "sinkType") | .value] | last // "kafka") as $sink | (if $sink == "kafka" then .kafka.topics elif $sink == "redisStream" then .redisStream.streams elif $sink == "mqtt" then .mqtt.topics else [] end // []) as $destinations | (if $app == "main_search_and_alerts_app.py" then (([.app[] | select(.name == "numWorkersForIncidentGeneration") | (.value | tonumber)] | last // 0) > 0) else (([.app[] | select(.name == "numWorkersForFrameEnhancement") | (.value | tonumber)] | last // 0) > 0) end) and (([.app[] | select(.name == "proximityViolationIncidentEnable") | .value] | last // "false") | ascii_downcase) == "true" and any($destinations[]?; .name == "incidents" and ((.value // "") | length > 0))' "$config_src"` returns exit 0. This proves the selected app's actual incident worker is enabled, proximity-violation incidents are enabled, and the active sink maps `incidents`.

The 1.8 value is the DISTANCE knob (`proximityDetectionThreshold`, meters, per-sensor) — NOT the incident persistence-duration knob (`proximityViolationIncidentThreshold`, seconds). They must not be confused.
